The discussion centered on preparing a dataset for comparison, specifically involving changes to the metro category data. It was decided that [p1] would update and upload the metro data into the existing staging dataset. The recipient ([me]) needs clarification from someone (Nastya) regarding the exact format required for comparison with release data.

*   The source of predictive metrics should be `device_session_agg_ml` rather than the staging version, as the staging version will only be used after the official release.
*   [p1] confirmed that the dataset can be updated in place (replacing STAGE) rather than creating a new one.

Following the data update, someone needs to analyze the aggregated results and inform Nastya about the findings.

Predictive metrics must be sourced from `device_session_agg_ml`.
